<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 211.0764 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ~210.0691 Da. The strong M+2 peak (~33 % of the base) indicates the presence of a single chlorine atom (⁷⁵Cl/³⁷Cl isotopic pattern). Accounting for one Cl (34.9689 Da) leaves ~175.1003 Da to be composed of C, H, and O. Searching integer combinations that match this remainder yields the formula C₈H₁₅O₄Cl, whose calculated exact mass (210.0659 Da) is within ~15 ppm of the observed neutral mass and reproduces the observed isotopic pattern (one Cl gives the ~33 % M+2 peak). Therefore, the molecular formula is C₈H₁₅O₄Cl.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H15O4Cl</final_answer>
